"""validate_rows: unusable rows dropped, later duplicate kept, sorted by (date, ticker)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import RawRow, validate_rows


def test_drops_missing_closes_and_sorts_by_date_then_ticker():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "B", 20.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", 19.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", None),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "A", 10.5),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", 19.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "A", 10.5),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "B", 20.0),
    ]


def test_drops_zero_and_negative_closes():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 0.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", -0.5),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "C", 0.01),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow("2024-01-02", "C", 0.01)]


def test_later_duplicate_in_file_order_wins():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 11.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 12.0),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 12.0)]


def test_unusable_later_duplicate_does_not_replace_a_usable_one():
    rows = [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0), RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", None)]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0)]


def test_keeps_only_the_requested_tickers():

"""validate_rows: unusable rows dropped, later duplicate kept, sorted by (date, ticker)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import RawRow, validate_rows


def test_drops_missing_closes_and_sorts_by_date_then_ticker():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "B", 20.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", 19.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", None),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "A", 10.5),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", 19.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "A", 10.5),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "B", 20.0),
    ]


def test_drops_zero_and_negative_closes():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 0.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", -0.5),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "C", 0.01),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow("2024-01-02", "C", 0.01)]


def test_later_duplicate_in_file_order_wins():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 11.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 12.0),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 12.0)]


def test_unusable_later_duplicate_does_not_replace_a_usable_one():
    rows = [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0), RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", None)]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0)]


def test_keeps_only_the_requested_tickers():
    rows = [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0), RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", 20.0)]

    rows = [RawRow("2024-01-02", "A", 10.0), RawRow("2024-01-02", "B", 0.0)]
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="B"):
        validate_rows(rows, ["A", "B"])
